previous_field.meaning: Append a prior-value flag (1 or 0) and the previous chosen field inside each exact key tuple, preserving encounter order. Use comma-separated key indices or all. First entries receive 0 and an empty value.

running_total.meaning: Append the signed 64-bit running sum of a chosen integer field within each key tuple in encounter order. Use all or comma-separated zero-based key indices.

rank_records.meaning: Append a one-based row number within each caller-selected key tuple under stable caller-selected ordering. Return rows in input order; use all or comma-separated key indices and encounter or column:type:direction keys.
